name: Vinya
source: Sampled from vinya-redesign/plates/perfect.jpg (1280×720). Text colors are darkened where the photo sample fails WCAG AA on paper.

paper.role: Page canvas. Straw cream shared with a working winery site.

ink.role: Text and primary buttons. Vine black. 14.3:1 on paper.

line.role: Hairline rules, table dividers, badge borders.

cellar.role: Dark surfaces. Same vine black as the ink.

grape.role: Grape body. Brand accent for marks and large UI, not a purple SaaS color. White type is 9.4:1.

grape-bloom.role: Bloom on the berry. Large type and icons on cellar only (5.0:1). Too light for small text on paper.

leaf.role: Leaf, darkened for text and positive numbers. 7.2:1 on paper. Photo leaf is #757e36; that sample is fills only.

leaf-fill.role: Leaf as sampled. Fills and large marks. 3.9:1 on paper — not for small text.

risk.role: A batch or a margin that needs a look today. 6.6:1 on card.

good.role: A line that is paying. 6.4:1 on card.

font.serif: Newsreader, Iowan Old Style, Georgia, serif
